messages:
sre-incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident opened: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 (detected by error-rate alert)
maria (oncall): seeing it, thanks. digging into logs now. pinging chris and ravi
chris (sre): on it. are we seeing model-side failures or infra? any customer-facing 500s?
lee (support): got two urgent customer tickets reporting timeouts and 502s, both on swiftpay integration
maria (oncall): initial grep shows a spike in `ModelRuntimeException` and `kv-cache-miss` churn. tailing logs: many requests hitting a single GPU host
ravi (platform): looks like autoscaler didn't spawn due to a qos lock. i can force-scale a node group but need permission
maria (oncall): please scale, +2 n1-gpus in us-west-2. also enabling temporary routing fallback to smaller quantized model: `rwd-neo-q8` for tiered responses
ravi (platform): scaling initiated. patching LB routing rule to prefer healthy pools. ETA ~90s
maria (oncall): ops-bot: announce mitigation plan and PD squelch for this incident
ops-bot: Posted: "Mitigation: scale +2, fallback to rwd-neo-q8, temporarily suppress PD for repeated identical 5xx alerts (60m)." :white_check_mark:
chris (sre): adding a hotfix: disable KV cache priming for requests above 8k tokens to avoid cache churn. patch on infra soon
maria (oncall): can we rate-limit burst traffic from the swiftpay integration for now? support can ask them to throttle for 10m
lee (support): reaching out to swiftpay now, cc'ing legal for any SLA issues
sre-incident-bot: PD: alertgroup "5xx-rate /v1/generate" muted for 60m by maria
maria (oncall): scaling finished, new nodes registered. traffic is beginning to spread across 3 hosts instead of 1. errors dropping
chris (sre): rolling the cache change to prod now. monitoring CPU and latency. if stable we'll keep it as a temporary setting
maria (oncall): confirm customer impact: Lee, any updates from tickets?
lee (support): customers acknowledge degraded but can accept reduced throughput for 30m. no revenue loss reported yet.
maria (oncall): good. switching to post-incident actions: we need to tune alerts so this doesn't cause PD noise again
chris (sre): agree. root cause is twofold: (1) autoscaler race/quota lock, (2) noisy alerting that pages for every host-level 5xx spike. propose: aggregate alerts by logical route+region and add cohort dedupe
ravi (platform): also add a rate-limit on PD triggers: only escalate after 3 aggregated breaches within 5m. we can implement server-side dedupe in the alerting layer
maria (oncall): list of immediate followups:
- dedupe rule: group by `route` + `region` + `error_class` (e.g., 5xx-service) to avoid N PDs when one cascade happens
- PD escalation: require 3 grouped alerts in 5m to trigger a page, otherwise log+slack
- threshold tweak: change error-rate alert to fire on >=3% errors sustained for 2m (current is 1%/1m)
- add dashboard panels for host distribution, KV cache miss rate, and autoscaler queue depth
- runbook update: during scale events, automatically silence host-level 5xx alerts for 10m to let autoscaler act
chris (sre): adding a sample alert rule snippet for the oncall infra team to review:
```
alert: HighRouteErrorRate
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",region="us-west-2",status=~"5.."}[1m]))
      / sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",region="us-west-2"}[1m])) > 0.03
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "High 5xx rate on /v1/generate ({{ $labels.region }})"
```
chris (sre): key is `group_interval` in alertmanager and `repeat_interval` in PD — set group_interval to 5m and ensure `group_by` includes route+region
ravi (platform): PD policy change: create a new escalation policy 'service-aggregate' which pages only on grouped alerts. open PR against terraform PD config
maria (oncall): dashboards: product metrics team (chris) please add panels for: host heatmap, request-to-host mapping, kv-cache-misses/s, autoscaler queue depth, and active PD counts
chris (sre): will do. also adding a small panel that shows recent PD events and the dedupe status so oncall can see when alerts are being squelched
lee (support): please add a customer-impact flag in the incident ticket template so we can quickly note degraded/partial/outage
maria (oncall): good call. i'll update runbook to include that and the explicit handoff checklist
chris (sre): schedule: i'll submit alerting PR today (patch for expr + group_by + for) and PD terraform PR by EOD. ravi can you review PD terraform change?
ravi (platform): will review. also proposing to add a soft rate limit at the LB that rejects large bursts with 429s and returns a `Retry-After` header - reduces cascade to model hosts
maria (oncall): let's not return 429 for critical customers. config should allow whitelist bypass. add that to the PR notes
chris (sre): postmortem note: autoscaler lock needs a watchdog. adding a cron job to detect locked queues and trigger an override if scaled_desired != scaled_actual for >3m
maria (oncall): handoff: i'm on shift until 11:00 PST, chris will be secondary until midnight. if anything re-escalates ping chris directly and i'll join asap
sre-incident-bot: Incident resolved: status moved to MONITORING. duration 42m. :white_check_mark:
maria (oncall): thanks everyone. follow-ups captured in the incident doc and will be assigned as tasks (alert PR, PD terraform, dashboard panels, runbook updates). assigning owners.
lee (support): copying customers with update now. no further incoming tickets as of last check
chris (sre): once PRs merge we'll roll out dedupe and the new thresholds in staging and monitor for a week before prod roll
ravi (platform): quick note: also adding a 120s cooldown on autoscaler to smooth out flapping.
maria (oncall): OK. if anyone wants to review the alert wording or grouping, ping me here. thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Scheduled: "alert-dedupe-rollout" for next Tue 09:00 PT. Reminder will post 24h before roll
maria (oncall): closing thread for now. will reopen if anything regresses.
